scripts.wasm: RUSTFLAGS='--cfg getrandom_backend="wasm_js"' wasm-pack build ../thaimeleon_lib --target web --no-default-features --features wasm && rm -rf src/wasm && cp -r ../thaimeleon_lib/pkg src/wasm
scripts.wasm-node: RUSTFLAGS='--cfg getrandom_backend="wasm_js"' wasm-pack build ../thaimeleon_lib --target nodejs --out-dir pkg-node --no-default-features --features wasm
scripts.gen-default: npm run wasm-node && node scripts/gen-default-schemes.mjs && rm -rf ../thaimeleon_lib/pkg-node
